newsitem.title: USA: Chrysalis stake of 22.4 pct held by group.
newsitem.headline: Chrysalis stake of 22.4 pct held by group.

text.p: A group including Alec Hakel, a private Swiss investor, said Thursday it holds a 22.4 percent stake in Chrysalis International Corp.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it acquired 2,547,448 common shares of Chrysalis when their company, BioClin International, merged with DNX Corp on August 19.
As part of the transaction, DNX, a drug development company based in Raritan, N.J., changed its name to Chrysalis.
The group includes John Christian Jensen, president of Chrysalis' international services and Jack Barbut, vice chairman and president of Chrysalis' clinical services.
